Drive & Campfire

  • 5:00 AM ETLeave Wesley Chapel, FL.

Packing

Clothes plan

Laundry runs twice. One simple backpack each - no duffles.

Day 1 (drive + campfire) Comfy car fit + light hiking + pajamas - light sweater, sweatpants, long-sleeve base, beanie.
Day 2 (waterfalls + cabin) Hiking fit + sweats/pajamas + swimsuit for the hot tub - hoodie, pants, rain jacket (maybe), long-sleeve base, beanie.

LAUNDRY

Day 3 (cave hike) Hiking fit - same hoodie/pants, different shirt; reuse swimsuit + PJs.

LAUNDRY

Day 4 (drive home) Rewear outfit.

To Film

Nine shots, in the order the trip happens. One shot per stop — about 20 seconds of usable footage each. Keep the HoverAir batteries in a jacket pocket between shots; 40s mornings drain them fast.

Thursday · Nov 5 — Before departure

Wesley Chapel & the van

  • 1Intros at the door — everyone at the front door, Wesley Chapel, before departure. The cold open.
    HoverAir · Hover
  • 2Changing seats shot — van parked, same angle at every stop so the seats shuffle in the edit. Repeat it at each stop.
    HoverAir · Orbit
Drone rule: Private property / parked only. Never fly from a moving vehicle.

Friday · Nov 6 — DeSoto State Park

Camp & DeSoto Falls

  • 3Campground set up cuts — tents going up at campsite 03.
    HoverAir · Follow / cuts
  • 4Zoom up campsite bird's eye — straight up over campsite 03 to the canopy.
    HoverAir · Bird's Eye
  • 5DeSoto Falls — follow someone (maybe), then the falls zoom out: start tight, pull back to the full 104-foot drop.
    HoverAir · Follow + Zoom Out
Drone rule — check first: Alabama has no statewide state-park drone ban; each park sets its own rules. Ask the park office / check signage on the day before flying. Personal, non-commercial filming only.

Saturday · Nov 7 — Falls & cabin

Noccalula, Lost Falls & the cabin

  • 6Noccalula Falls — follow someone (maybe), then the falls zoom out to the full 90-foot drop.
    HoverAir · Follow + Zoom Out
Drone rule — check first: Noccalula Falls Park is a Gadsden city park; no specific drone rule verified. Check with the park at entry before flying.
  • 7Lost Falls / Laurel Falls Loop — slow circle around the group at the falls.
    HoverAir · Orbit
Drone rule — check first: Same as the rest of DeSoto State Park — no statewide ban, each park sets its own rules. Ask the park office / check signage on the day; personal, non-commercial filming only.
  • 8Cabin shots — on the deck, on the grass, and an inside orbit. Fort Payne cabin, 1975 County Rd 275.
    HoverAir · Orbit (inside) + deck / grass shots
Drone rule: Private rental — host permission required. Fly only over the rental property and respect the neighbours.
